name: Pole Training
description:
You gain martial training in all grades of the Acrobat's Pole, a special weapon type.

Whenever you make an attack with an Acrobat's Pole, you may either make one attack against one creature or two attacks against two different creatures.

Describe your technique.

improvements.name: Vault
improvements.description:
Once per round, you may use your Acrobat's Pole to enhance your movement. Choose one:

  • Your jump distance is doubled for your next jump this turn.

  • Your jump height is doubled for your next jump this turn.

  • You negate 10 ft of falling damage.

In either case, the increase does not cost you additional movement.

improvements.name: Moulinette
improvements.description: When you make a melee attack with an Acrobat's Pole and land a hit, you may spend 1 additional action to attack all creatures within reach simultaneously with the same single attack roll, skipping Engagement.

improvements.name: Sweep The Leg
improvements.description: When you make a melee attack with an Acrobat's Pole and land a hit, you may spend an additional action to roll Dexterity vs Dexterity against the creature you hit. On a win, the creature is knocked prone, and if the hit was part of a Moulinette attack, you may repeat the Dexterity vs Dexterity roll against each subsequent target of this attack until you lose.
